calculation.description: Fade the completed session open-to-close directional shock, normalized by a 20-session true-range average computed only through t-1. Higher values indicate a stronger candidate for next-period rebound.

validation.regime_notes: Validation covers the available 2026 online period only; the small cross-asset panel averages 12 valid instruments per date. Positive IC was observed at 1, 5, and 10 sessions, but uncertainty is material due to 101 dates and short regime span.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark daily gates: absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Full artifact-level library correlation was not independently recoverable in this run; deterministic post-Miner screening must recompute it.
